title: Video by orbit.media.in
caption:
The best VCs don’t just invest, They broadcast.

Capital is no longer scarce.
Great founders aren’t either.

What’s scarce is trust at scale.

Media distribution turns a VC from a logo on a website
into a familiar voice in a founder’s head.

When founders hear your thinking weekly,
your firm stops competing on valuation
and starts competing on belief.

That’s the power of distribution.

title: Video by calderdune
caption:
A Meditation on Men.

Dune and Oppenheimer are films that mean a ton to me, and this was an exercise in filtering my thoughts through the powerful themes present in them. Paul and Robert are two men who are extremely complex, and who are burdened with a path that leads to great power, and destruction. 

This is not an opinion on all men, but those who end up in the magnetic field of power.

caption:
Growing up looking ethnic with a strong Aussie accent meant “where are you from?” was always the question I got most.

Honestly, I never knew how to answer it.

Too Argentine for Australia. Too Australian for Argentina.
For a long time that felt like a problem.

But to be honest I just love being both!

title: Video by tomcflower
caption:
I used to think switching off meant falling behind or losing everything I’d worked so hard to build.

Two weeks driving across the bottom of Australia taught me the opposite.

Life offline is what fuels everything that happens online.

You don’t need to delete social media.
You don’t need to post every day.

Block out your weekends.
Go outside.
Come back with something worth saying.

Your story is what makes you worth listening to.
